text:
emma: flagging post-deploy smoke for /inference-probe on canary (5%). sudden p95 jump ~2.8x and error rate from 0.15% -> 0.9%. holding ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy bot: rollout v5.2.2 -> v5.2.3 at 1761812200, canary 5%. smoke probes started 1761812260. failing probes: 26/200 in last 10m.

monitor-bot: recent metrics snapshot: p95 420ms (baseline 150ms), p99 980ms, 5xx rate 0.9%, spike onset 1761812340. CPU on canary boxes normal. KV cache miss rate +15% at same time window.

oliver: we shipped a small routing change that prefers remote shards for cold keys (optimize_fanout=true). could be increasing KV miss pressure and causing tail. no model or kernel work.

sre-oncall: recommendation: gate rollout. Plan A: revert optimize_fanout via canary-only config override and restart probes. Plan B: if no improvement in 12m, pin canary traffic to v5.2.2 and open rollback window.

emma: prefer config override first to avoid actual rollback. if we flip optimize_fanout=false on canary canary-only, propagation ~30s.

ops-bot: config patch command (canary-only):
```
POST /internal/configs/overrides
{ "scope":"canary", "optimize_fanout": false }
```
Applying now at 1761812400.

deploy-bot: config change accepted (tx 5f4e2). restarting synthetic runners 1761812420 -> collecting 50 samples/min targeted at /inference-probe.

monitor-bot: 4m after override: p95 down to 190ms, p99 420ms, 5xx rate 0.3%, KV cache miss delta back to baseline.

oliver: that looks like the culprit. we'll revert the routing tweak in the next patch and add stronger canary gate checks for fanout config.

sre-oncall: hold will remain for 12m observation window. criteria to resume ramp: sustained p95 within 1.2x baseline and 5xx <0.5% for window.

emma: leaving hold in place. if metrics hold for 12m we resume to 30% and follow-up with release notes: "temporary canary routing override due to KV miss amplification; fix scheduled."

ops-bot: reminder: if pin needed: POST /api/routing/pin {"route":"/inference-probe","version":"v5.2.2","scope":"canary"} (ops auth required).

deploy-bot: observation running. will post final verdict at 1761812705.

monitor-bot: 12m mark: stable metrics, p95 160ms, 5xx 0.2%. hold released at 1761812705, resuming gradual ramp.

emma: resolving hold and marking this thread as ops history. follow-up ticket created: ENG-OPT-913 for routing fanout revert and added synth test for fanout configs.
